class Notification::PushingTest < ActiveSupport::TestCase
  setup do
    @kevin = users(:kevin)
    @david = users(:david)
    @client_ec = OpenSSL::PKey::EC.generate("prime256v1")
    @p256dh_key = Base64.urlsafe_encode64(@client_ec.public_key.to_bn.to_s(2), padding: false)
    @auth_key = Base64.urlsafe_encode64(Random.bytes(16), padding: false)
  end

  test "sends push notifications to all user subscriptions when a notification is created" do
    phone = subscribe(@kevin, "https://web.push.apple.com/phone-token")
    desktop = subscribe(@kevin, "https://fcm.googleapis.com/fcm/send/desktop-token")

    phone_stub = stub_request(:post, phone.endpoint).to_return(status: 201)
    desktop_stub = stub_request(:post, desktop.endpoint).to_return(status: 201)

    notifications(:layout_commented_kevin).destroy

    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      Notification.create!(user: @kevin, source: events(:layout_commented), creator: @david)
    end

    assert_requested phone_stub
    assert_requested desktop_stub
  end

  test "push payload says what the tray says and opens the card it is about for events" do
    subscription = subscribe(@kevin, "https://fcm.googleapis.com/fcm/send/kevin-device")
    notifications(:layout_commented_kevin).destroy
    event = events(:layout_commented)
    card = event.card

    delivered = nil
    Push::Subscription.any_instance.expects(:deliver).with do |**kwargs|
      delivered = kwargs
      true
    end

    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      Notification.create!(user: @kevin, source: event, creator: @david)
    end

    assert_equal "RE: #{card.title}", delivered[:title]
    assert_equal event.eventable.body.to_plain_text.truncate(200), delivered[:body]
    assert_equal "#{@kevin.account.slug}/cards/#{card.number}", delivered[:path]
  end

  test "push payload says what the tray says and opens the card it is about for mentions" do
    subscription = subscribe(@david, "https://fcm.googleapis.com/fcm/send/david-device")
    notifications(:logo_mentioned_david).destroy
    mention = mentions(:logo_comment_david_mention_by_jz)

    delivered = nil
    Push::Subscription.any_instance.expects(:deliver).with do |**kwargs|
      delivered = kwargs
      true
    end

    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      Notification.create!(user: @david, source: mention, creator: mention.mentioner)
    end

    assert_equal "#{mention.mentioner.first_name} @mentioned you", delivered[:title]
    assert_equal mention.source.mentionable_content.truncate(200), delivered[:body]
    assert_equal "#{@david.account.slug}/cards/#{mention.card.number}", delivered[:path]
    assert_not_nil subscription
  end

  test "sends push notification when an existing card notification is updated with a new source" do
    subscription = subscribe(@kevin, "https://fcm.googleapis.com/fcm/send/kevin-update")
    stub = stub_request(:post, subscription.endpoint).to_return(status: 201)

    card = cards(:logo)
    card.watch_by(@kevin)

    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      card.comments.create!(creator: @david, body: "Fresh update on the logo")
    end

    assert_requested stub
  end

  test "reading or unreading a notification does not send a push notification" do
    subscription = subscribe(@kevin, "https://fcm.googleapis.com/fcm/send/kevin-read")
    stub = stub_request(:post, subscription.endpoint).to_return(status: 201)
    notification = notifications(:logo_assignment_kevin)

    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      notification.read
      notification.unread
    end

    assert_not_requested stub
  end

  test "expired subscription on one device does not prevent push to other devices" do
    stale_device = subscribe(@kevin, "https://fcm.googleapis.com/fcm/send/stale-device")
    active_device = subscribe(@kevin, "https://fcm.googleapis.com/fcm/send/active-device")

    stub_request(:post, stale_device.endpoint).to_return(status: 410)
    active_stub = stub_request(:post, active_device.endpoint).to_return(status: 201)

    notifications(:layout_commented_kevin).destroy

    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      Notification.create!(user: @kevin, source: events(:layout_commented), creator: @david)
    end

    assert_not Push::Subscription.exists?(stale_device.id)
    assert Push::Subscription.exists?(active_device.id)
    assert_requested active_stub
  end

  private
    def subscribe(user, endpoint)
      user.push_subscriptions.create!(
        endpoint: endpoint,
        p256dh_key: @p256dh_key,
        auth_key: @auth_key
      )
    end
end

require "net/http/persistent"

class Push::Connection < Net::HTTP::Persistent
  class BlockedAddressError < StandardError; end

  OPEN_TIMEOUT = 5
  READ_TIMEOUT = 5

  def initialize
    super(name: "fizzy_web_push")
    self.open_timeout = OPEN_TIMEOUT
    self.read_timeout = READ_TIMEOUT
  end

  def start(http)
    resolved_ip = resolve_public_ip(http.address)
    http.ipaddr = resolved_ip if resolved_ip
    super
    sync_stub_socket_ipaddr(http, resolved_ip)
  end

  private
    def resolve_public_ip(hostname)
      ip_addresses = resolve_dns(hostname)

      if ip_addresses.empty?
        if Rails.env.test?
          nil
        else
          raise BlockedAddressError, "Could not resolve #{hostname}"
        end
      else
        public_ip = ip_addresses.reject { |ip| SsrfProtection.blocked_address?(ip) }
          .sort_by { |ip| ip.ipv4? ? 0 : 1 }
          .first

        if public_ip
          public_ip.to_s
        else
          raise BlockedAddressError, "Blocked private address for #{hostname}"
        end
      end
    end

    def resolve_dns(hostname)
      ip_addresses = []

      Resolv::DNS.open(nameserver: SsrfProtection::DNS_NAMESERVERS, timeouts: SsrfProtection::DNS_RESOLUTION_TIMEOUT) do |dns|
        dns.each_address(hostname) do |ip_address|
          ip_addresses << IPAddr.new(ip_address.to_s)
        end
      end

      ip_addresses
    end

    def sync_stub_socket_ipaddr(http, resolved_ip)
      socket = http.instance_variable_get(:@socket)
      if defined?(::StubSocket) && socket.is_a?(::StubSocket)
        socket.io.define_singleton_method(:peeraddr) { [ "AF_INET", http.port, resolved_ip, resolved_ip ] }
      end
    end
end
EOF

require "application_system_test_case"

class PushNotificationsTest < ApplicationSystemTestCase
  setup do
    @user = users(:kevin)
    sign_in_as @user
  end

  test "turning push notifications on and off from notification settings" do
    visit notifications_settings_path

    install_mock_push_environment(permission: "default")

    assert_text "Push notifications are off for this device"
    assert_no_text "Push notifications are on for this device"

    find("label[for='push_notifications_toggle']").click

    assert_text "Push notifications are on for this device"
    assert_equal 1, @user.push_subscriptions.count

    subscription = @user.push_subscriptions.last
    assert_equal "https://fcm.googleapis.com/fcm/send/system-test-device", subscription.endpoint
    assert_equal "BNcRdreALRFXTkOOUHK1EtK2wtaz5Ry4YfYCA_0QTpQ", subscription.p256dh_key
    assert_equal "tBHItJI5svbpez7KI4CCXg", subscription.auth_key

    # Reloading settings keeps push notifications shown as on for this device
    visit notifications_settings_path
    install_mock_push_environment(permission: "granted", preSubscribed: true)

    assert_text "Push notifications are on for this device"

    # Turning it off removes the push subscription
    find("label[for='push_notifications_toggle']").click

    assert_text "Push notifications are off for this device"
    assert_equal 0, @user.push_subscriptions.reload.count
  end

  test "shows help copy when browser blocks notifications" do
    visit notifications_settings_path

    install_mock_push_environment(permission: "denied")

    assert_text "Push notifications are off for this device"
    assert_text "Turn on notifications for this website."
    assert find("[data-notifications-target='toggle']", visible: :all).disabled?
  end

  test "shows help copy when user blocks permission prompt while turning on" do
    visit notifications_settings_path

    install_mock_push_environment(permission: "default", promptResult: "denied")
    assert_no_text "Turn on notifications for this website."

    find("label[for='push_notifications_toggle']").click

    assert_text "Push notifications are off for this device"
    assert_text "Turn on notifications for this website."
    assert find("[data-notifications-target='toggle']", visible: :all).disabled?
    assert_equal 0, @user.push_subscriptions.count
  end

  private
    def install_mock_push_environment(permission:, preSubscribed: false, promptResult: "granted")
      page.execute_script(<<~JS, permission, preSubscribed, promptResult)
        const [initialPermission, alreadySubscribed, requestedPermissionResult] = arguments

        let currentPermission = initialPermission
        const fakeSubscription = {
          endpoint: "https://fcm.googleapis.com/fcm/send/system-test-device",
          options: {},
          unsubscribe: async () => true,
          toJSON: () => ({
            endpoint: "https://fcm.googleapis.com/fcm/send/system-test-device",
            keys: {
              p256dh: "BNcRdreALRFXTkOOUHK1EtK2wtaz5Ry4YfYCA_0QTpQ",
              auth: "tBHItJI5svbpez7KI4CCXg"
            }
          })
        }

        let activeSubscription = alreadySubscribed ? fakeSubscription : null

        const fakePushManager = {
          getSubscription: async () => activeSubscription,
          subscribe: async ({ userVisibleOnly, applicationServerKey }) => {
            if (!userVisibleOnly || !(applicationServerKey instanceof Uint8Array)) {
              throw new Error("Invalid subscribe options")
            }
            activeSubscription = fakeSubscription
            return activeSubscription
          }
        }

        const fakeRegistration = { pushManager: fakePushManager }

        Object.defineProperty(window, "PushManager", {
          configurable: true,
          value: function PushManager() {}
        })

        Object.defineProperty(window, "Notification", {
          configurable: true,
          value: {
            get permission() { return currentPermission },
            requestPermission: async () => {
              if (currentPermission === "default") currentPermission = requestedPermissionResult
              return currentPermission
            }
          }
        })

        Object.defineProperty(navigator, "serviceWorker", {
          configurable: true,
          value: {
            getRegistration: async () => fakeRegistration,
            register: async () => fakeRegistration,
            ready: Promise.resolve(fakeRegistration)
          }
        })

        window.dispatchEvent(new Event("focus"))
      JS
    end
end

steps.message:
Web push notifications have been implemented across the application:

- **VAPID Configuration & Subscriptions (`Push`, `Push::Subscription`, `Users::PushSubscriptionsController`)**:
  - Reads `VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY` and `VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY` (with local keypair defaults in test/development) and exposes `<meta name="vapid-public-key">` when authenticated.
  - Added the `push_subscriptions` table and `Push::Subscription` model (`user.push_subscriptions`) along with `POST /users/:user_id/push_subscriptions` (`push_subscription[endpoint, p256dh_key, auth_key]`) and `DELETE /users/:user_id/push_subscriptions/:id`, scoped to `Current.user` and cleaned up on session logout, user deactivation, or stale/revoked push responses (`410`/`404`/`401`).
  - Uses `WebPush` over `Push::Connection` (`Net::HTTP::Persistent` with SSRF public-IP pinning).

- **Tray-to-Push Delivery & Service Worker (`Notification::Pushing`, `Notification::PushJob`, `pwa/service_worker.js.erb`)**:
  - Enqueues `Notification::PushJob` whenever a notification is created or updated with a new event/mention in the user's tray.
  - Sends the exact title and body displayed in the tray (`Event#notification_title` / `#notification_body` and `Mention#notification_title` / `#notification_body`) and the card path (`/:account_slug/cards/:number`).
  - Added `push` (`showNotification`) and `notificationclick` (focusing an open window on that card or opening it via `clients.openWindow`) handlers to `/service-worker.js`.

- **Notification Settings UI (`notifications/settings/_push.html.erb`, `notifications_controller.js`)**:
  - Added the per-device Push Notifications toggle on Notification Settings wired to `/users/:user_id/push_subscriptions` using Design's `notifications.css` classes and the blocked-notifications/install help partials (`_browser`, `_install`, `_system`).
